next.reason: 1985: 'the associated mnemonic-name may be specified only in the ACCEPT, DISPLAY, SEND, or WRITE statements'; 2023: 'Mnemonic-name-2 may be specified only in the WRITE statement... Mnemonic-name-3 may be specified only in the ACCEPT and DISPLAY statements'. 2023 drops SEND, ties feature-name mnemonics to WRITE and device-name mnemonics to ACCEPT/DISPLAY, and lets the implementor add further restrictions.
